d: A stylized humanoid creature featuring a smooth, featureless face and an apparent maturity of an ancient, enigmatic entity. The build is extremely slender and elongated, draped in flowing, organic fabrics and armor in a palette of deep charcoal, muted gold, and vibrant lime green. Signature details include a high, sweeping collar of charcoal and lime green, a curved headpiece with small glowing green orbs, and a swirling mass of ethereal green energy emanating from the base. BODY COLOR: Deep charcoal and lime green LEGS: Plantigrade, though mostly obscured by flowing garments.
